content.thinking: Fixing a few wording issues: swapping "within about a minute" for "quickly," and adjusting the preposition from "from" to "over" in a couple of the references.

action_items.item: Run the new tests in PR #328 against the current code to see whether the monthly spend path really raises ZeroDivisionError for a shopper with no purchases this month, as Code-Fix's reading says.
Require tests of the code path behind a feature flag, including shoppers with no purchases in the current month, before the flag can be switched on in production.
Roll out monthly-spend-feature and flags like it to a small share of traffic first, and switch them off automatically when the account page error rate rises.
Link the HighErrorRate alert on io-shop to an on-call page so that a person is told when it fires.

causal_chain.step: Shoppers' account page requests failed. The share of requests ending in a server error rose from {errors_before} before the onset to {errors_while_broken} on average while it was broken, peaking at {errors_at_worst}.
Account page requests were failing with ZeroDivisionError in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. These errors were logged over {G5309.3} and not before the onset.

ruled_out.what: A deploy or other production change: the change events for the day before the onset returned only the flag change, and the deploy search returned nothing.
Another flag change: the flag provider showed only one flag change by anyone but Argus in the hour it read, which is the monthly-spend-feature toggle.
Shoppers closing the connection: ClientDisconnected failures were logged over {G46bc.3}, starting before the onset, while account pages rendered normally and the error rate was at its baseline.

causal_chain.step: Account page requests were going down the monthly spend code path because the feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on by admin at {P1.1}. The flag logs show it off for every evaluation over {G7e5d.4}, partly on at {G971b.1}, and on for every evaluation over {Gce95.4}. Switching the flag off brought the service back, and that action was judged confirmed.

The monthly path breaks because `average_spend_per_item_this_month` divides the month's spend by the number of purchases flagged `in_current_month`. For a shopper who has bought before but not this month, that number is {F1.1}, so it raises ZeroDivisionError at line {F1.2}. This rests on Code-Fix's reading of the source; nothing has run it.

input.cause_in_plain_words: Switching on a new feature for shoppers' account pages sent those pages through new code that crashed, likely because it divides by the number of purchases made this month, and that number is nothing for shoppers who have not bought anything yet this month.

contributing_factors.factor: No test or check was seen that ran the monthly spend path for a shopper with no purchases this month before monthly-spend-feature was switched on in production.
contributing_factors.had_it_been_otherwise: A test like that would have hit the ZeroDivisionError before the flag reached shoppers, and the flag would not have been switched on with the fault in place.

contributing_factors.factor: The flag went from off to on for every evaluation very quickly: partly on at {G971b.1}, then all on over {Gce95.4}. No staged rollout and no automatic halt on rising errors was seen.
contributing_factors.had_it_been_otherwise: Only a small share of shoppers would have reached the failing path before the rise in errors stopped the rollout, so the incident would have been smaller and shorter.

went_well: The Investigator formed a single candidate, the monthly-spend-feature toggle, {T13.1 - T3.1} after it was called in, and the record confirmed it.

The Mitigation Agent switched monthly-spend-feature off {T18.1 - alert_raised} after the alert was raised. The action could be undone, and it was judged confirmed once the service was no longer at the incident's level.
Code-Fix proposed a draft fix with tests (PR #328) for a person to review. It returns {F1.4} when nothing was bought this month, keeps the return type and leaves the lifetime path untouched.
went_wrong: The alert fired but nobody was paged: no on-call incident was linked to it.

input.root_cause: Switching on monthly-spend-feature sent account page rendering through `average_spend_per_item_this_month` in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. That function divides the month's spend by the number of purchases flagged `in_current_month` and does not guard against that number being {F1.1}. For a shopper who has bought before but not this month, it raises ZeroDivisionError at line {F1.2}, and the account page request fails.
input.still_at_risk: Only the flag was switched off, so the division in the monthly spend code is still there, and switching monthly-spend-feature back on would likely make account pages fail again for shoppers with no purchases this month.
input.symptom: Account pages failed for many shoppers
